name: v1.11.0
body:

* Feat: Application-Scoped Policies by @briankane in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7067

* Fix: Pin scaffolded go.mod to running vela binary's version in def init-module by @jerrinfrancis in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7097

* Feat: auto remediate cue issues by @briankane in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7199
* Feat: Added new deploy-components workflow step by @vishal210893 in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7213

* Fix: vela status reports Healthy on workflowFailed with empty services by @kampitojha in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7233
* Fix: propagate CUE health-eval errors from GetStatus and mirror trait path fix by @Himanshu-370 in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7226
* Docs: remove dead webhook README links in WEBHOOK_DEBUGGING.md by @anxkhn in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7219
* Fix: storage trait mountToEnv should replace existing env value by @Harsh63870 in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7217
* Fix: reject non-revision names in ExtractRevision by @anxkhn in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7210
* Fix: make podDisruptive actually trigger pod restart . by @ankitkumarrain in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7231
* Docs: fix tickgit link in vela-core chart README by @Harsh63870 in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7216
* Fix: nil pointer panic in getMatchingDefinitionRevision on malformed revision version by @anxkhn in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7207

* Fix: support configurable timeout via request.timeout in http builtin by @Paranitharan1110 in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7239
* Docs: Cluster Infrastructure Abstraction — Declarative Lifecycle, Composition, and Fleet Rollouts by @anoop2811 in https://github.com/kubevela/kubevela/pull/7087
